network_status.network: OCDPC 226/2015 - Piano degli interventi, Allegato B
network_status.summary_it: Il piano regionale documenta che le piogge del 15-16 novembre causarono la piena dello Staffora e l'erosione delle fondazioni delle pile a Salice Terme, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata dell'evento. La descrizione del danno resta distinta da una misura idrometrica.
network_status.summary_en: The regional plan documents that rainfall on 15-16 November caused the Staffora flood and erosion of bridge-pier foundations at Salice Terme, but publishes no event stage or discharge. The damage description remains distinct from a hydrometric measurement.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
